scientific_integrity: The proof derives the selected residual expectation from the exact maximum-of-exponentials law, uses the independent Gamma pooled-spacing statistic, and obtains the risk difference algebraically. Strict monotonicity proves threshold uniqueness. Numerical quadrature only replays consequences of the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the symmetric one-best versus tied-rest parameter ray and two simple affine corrections. It does not solve the full k-population risk geometry or establish global admissibility/minimaxity. Full text of Vellaisamy (2003) was unavailable in checked lawful routes, leaving a material bibliographic risk.
title: Exact one-versus-rest risk crossover for selected exponential locations
